comments: Child answers 'I don't know' to the mother's question 'bakit kaya?' (why?), denying knowledge of the cause.
In a magic game of hiding things, the child says 'wala na' (it's gone), asserting the absence of the object.
Child says 'dito muna' (stay here first) and uses the negation to justify delaying a move; mother's uptake 'sige basahin mo' confirms the refusal to move yet.
Child resists the anticipated event of being bumped during a game, responding to mother's prompts in lines 13877, 13881, and 13883.
Child refuses the mother's proposal/question about wanting to bump/crash (line 13757).
Child responds to 'what is that dog doing?' with 'wala', indicating that nothing is happening or the action is absent.
Child denies mother's narrative assertion about calling the dog, stating instead that they are playing.
Child denies that the object they are holding is a 'bantay' in response to Mother's request to get one (line 23628).
Child resists mother's directive to clean up or look at something (lines 24623-24632), confirmed by mother's frustration in line 24634.
Child refuses the proposed action of taking a bath mentioned in line 22728.
The child makes a factual claim about their physical state ('I am not feeling cold'), which is a truth claim.
Child refuses the toy offered by the mother in lines 13180-13182, requesting it be put back (line 13185).
Child refuses the mother's directive to tidy up (line 23726).
Child is refusing the object (cooking toy) mentioned in line 13834; this is a move of rejection.
Child asks if the mother knows about the operation; this is a question about a fact/state of knowledge, not a refusal of an action.
Child responds to the mother's question 'bakit siya ininjectionan?' by denying knowledge of the reason.
Child uses 'yayaw' (variant of 'ayaw' - don't want) to refuse the current situation/singing to sleep.
Child refuses the proposed activity of riding a motorcycle with Kuya Tigas (lines 13264, 13269).
Child refuses the mother's proposal to do a check-up in line 12927.
Child refuses an item offered by the mother in lines 22595-22596; mother's response in 22599 ("eto na lang") confirms the rejection.
The child denies being scared in response to the mother's prompt 'ikaw?' following a discussion about Basti being scared.
The child contradicts the mother's claim in line 38695 that they are not sleepy, asserting instead that they are sleeping.
Child asks a negative question about whether someone is eating, seeking confirmation of a fact.
The child makes a factual claim about the identity of the object ('not a monkey'), which is a truth claim and thus a Denial.
Child states the balloons are gone in response to Mother's question in line 90054; repeats previous statement from line 90055.
The token 'tawag' (call/summon) is a verb, not a negation.
Child answers the mother's question 'may sakit ako?' (Am I sick?) with 'wala', asserting the nonexistence of an illness.
Child asserts a factual claim about their emotional state ('I am not afraid'), which is a Denial.
The child is refusing the toy (cow) being presented by the mother, which is a move of Rejection.
Child is imitating the mother's previous utterance 'hindi po!' as indicated by the [=! imitates] marker.
Child refuses the mother's directive to tidy up in line 23726.
Child claims the egg is gone ('wala na'), which is a claim of nonexistence; Mother's response 'meron pa' (there is still some) confirms this interpretation.
Child responds to the mother's question 'ano nangyare kaya?' (what happened?) by stating they do not know, which is a factual claim.
